name: Binary Greedy Meshing with Transparency Support
aliases: Binary Greedy Mesher with Transparency Support
definition: A greedy meshing algorithm that supports partial transparency in voxel textures (e.g., glass) and opaque blocks with gaps (e.g., doors) by generating face masks that include transparent voxels adjacent to solid ones, ensuring correct visibility and minimal face count.
summary: Binary Greedy Meshing with Transparency Support extends standard meshing to correctly render transparent voxels by distinguishing solid from transparent states, preventing over-culling while maintaining minimal face counts.
